title: Give kept naming an actionable result when its Prepared owner belongs to another retained run
outcome: Kept/no-event naming either refreshes the correct caller-owned association safely or gives accurate retry advice for a foreign-run Prepared owner.
acceptance: A deterministic control replaces the Prepared owner with another retained run while preserving the selected root and verifies safe refusal or bounded recovery under the actual caller binding.
The response identifies the supported recovery and does not imply a root was installed or grant a different run authority; ordinary and changed-binding controls remain meaningful.
